reviews.text: I live 1 block away from here, I drive by this place every day & have friends who use this vet. Recently I was reading about new supplements & medications to treat cloudy eye syndrome for dogs & called here to see what over the counter treatment they would recommend . She placed me on hold for a few minutes & then told me she could not recommend anything and I would need to make an appointment with the doctor there. It's ridiculous that they know what I should use but will only tell me IF I schedule an appointment (Which is NOT cheap per my friend) Looks like they don't really care about the health of your dog - their top priority seems to be their bank account balance. Neighborhood veterinarian- yeah right. I am sure I can find someone who will tell me what's recommended-and they will get a great review. This place is just in it for the money.

I've taken my senior cat (Riley, about 16 years old and about to be 17) to them twice. They are so thorough, kind, gentle, and educational! I say educational because they did educate me regarding Riley, cats, meds, affects of medicine etc (which i greatly appreciated). They were very gentle with my 'Brothy Bro' ). Expensive but worth it. They care.
Have used NKVC for many years and many dogs and appreciate the excellent care they give my pets.  And me.

I was asked to stand outside of the building, as I first entered, even though the lobby had empty chairs. When he was taken to the back to get shots, he had an accident. They did not clean him up-they brought him back to the lobby covered in feces. They offered not help to clean him up, nor did they even offer paper towels or wipies. Another patient's owner went to her car tp get some for me, as feces was dripping on the floor. They staff did come back out to get my credit card and signiture. I dropped my card on the way out. I called back, but they said they did not see it. I had just left the building- it had to be there.  I will take my pets elsewhere.
Amanda is the worst provider I have had. She's rude, and should be kept far away from people
Extremely compassionate, very reasonable prices. Wonderful people

Extremely unprofessional. My wife is a stay at home mother who had to take our daughters to the vet for our dog when she heard the vet and another individual judging her parenting. Also our dog went in because she cries and whimpers randomly when moving, or jumping. She was told it can be valley fever or a spine issue. They just want a reason to jack up the price with multiple tests or are not very good at their job. Either way. Stay away from this vet.

We have been coming here for nearly 2 years for regular check up and vaccination.

But, today was our first visit with Dr. Alyssa Show, I can genuinely say, she is the best Vet, and with what we saw, the most thorough doctor we’ve seen since moving to Phoenix. I appreciated her people skills in talking to us, not making us feel like guilty pet owners, yet being clear on a potential outcome/worst case scenario.
We made sure that we will be requesting her for any and all follow up visits, even if we have to change our own schedules.

The vet tech today was also amazing, I wish I got her name, she was SO kind, caring, I was sitting on the floor with my baby, and she met me at my level, she sat on the floor to offer him extra water, explain the medication, answer questions.

By far, today was the best care we’ve ever received.

Thank you Dr. Show; and team! ❤️
Thank you, Mary, for your 5-star rating! We're thrilled to know you had a positive experience with us. We look forward to serving you again soon!

I’m so glad I found this vet! I’ll be taking all of my animals here for as long as I live in Phoenix.

The vet was extremely knowledgeable about my dog’s skin/allergy condition and went over all options with me in such a kind manner. My previous vets would speed through appointments, but she was more than happy to answer every single question I had and spent so much time with my dog. I didn’t feel rushed at all and left feeling confident that I had the information I needed to choose my dog’s treatment plan.

The techs are equally incredible with how they treated both me and my dog. My dog is pretty big and can get nervous in new situations. The techs were so patient and gentle with him and made the whole appointment as easy as possible for him.

All pricing is more than fair and completely transparent. They were open about all treatment options and their realistic outcomes and I didn’t feel guilted or pushed into more expensive options.

It’s clear that everyone here is genuinely passionate about animals. Thank you guys!

This clinic told me that my dog’s teeth looked good and didn’t need to be cleaned for at least another 6 months. Upon taking him to get his teeth cleaned elsewhere shortly after, they informed me that 8 of his teeth had to be removed that day due to rotting. The North Kenilworth staff seemed afraid of my dog, who is large but has never acted aggressively toward anybody or ever had an issue at another vet. They barely looked at his teeth for this reason, which is unfortunately why I didn’t learn about the issue upon this visit :(

I LOVE North Kenilworth Veterinary Care! The pick up the phone, they are EXCELLENT at answering questions on the phone. The visits are well priced! And the doctors and staff-AMAZING! The babies seem to not be as afraid of the staff. My Li Li does not need to be muzzled during exams...at least that I know of. My Delilah was VERY well cared for until and even at her passing. They did dental work on Li Li and she is like a NEW puppy even though eventually all of her teeth were extracted.
She is doing AMAZING! THANK YOU for EVERYTHING! I love this practice and recommend any chance I get!

I am sharing this review because I genuinely want other pet owners to be aware of my experience with Dr. Shaw and the dental procedure performed on my dog, Penny.
Penny is a 3-pound dog who underwent a dental cleaning and multiple extractions under Dr. Shaw’s care. During the procedure, I received a call stating that six teeth needed to be removed, including a back upper molar located very close to the eye/orbital area. At no point was I advised to consider referral to a veterinary dental specialist despite Penny’s extremely small size and the complexity/risk associated with that area. I also was not informed of the serious potential complications that could occur.
Following the procedure, Penny developed worsening symptoms including swelling around the eye, pain, fever, decreased appetite, and visible distress. We returned multiple times seeking help. According to the medical records, the extraction site was documented as “difficult to see due to size of patient,” yet Penny was discharged without additional diagnostics or escalation of care.
The next morning, an emergency hospital immediately identified active purulent drainage coming from the extraction site. CT imaging and specialists later confirmed a severe abscess and infection tract extending from the extraction area into the orbital region behind Penny’s eye.
Despite emergency treatment and specialist intervention, the infection progressed to the point that Penny ultimately lost her eye.
This experience has been devastating emotionally, physically, and financially for our family. We incurred nearly $12,000 in emergency and specialty veterinary expenses as a direct result of these complications.
What was also deeply upsetting was the complete lack of personal accountability or compassion afterward. Dr. Shaw never personally called to check on Penny following the loss of her eye, and at no point did she apologize for what happened.
I understand that complications can occur in medicine, but I believe pet owners deserve full transparency about risks, especially in medically delicate cases involving very small dogs and complex extractions. I also believe cases like this should be referred to appropriately trained dental specialists when necessary.
I would strongly encourage anyone considering advanced dental work for a very small dog to ask detailed questions about experience, training, specialty referral options, and risk before proceeding.

I have been a client of North Kennelworth for 15 years.  My dog Cinderella was in their care for almost 12 years before going on to the rainbow bridge. I drive from Sun City to DT Phoenix as I believe this is where my dog Bodhi will get his best care.  Not only does the staff care for Bodhi but they care for me as well.  Thank you Dr Show and every vet tech that has touched and cared for both Cinderella and Bodhi 🐶🐾.

We have been going to North Kenilworth since 2020 and have had great experiences with all of the veterinary staff from routine visits to unplanned appointments. They are caring and patient with our dogs, who can be very timid at the vet. They have always been very responsive through phone and the app.

Recently we have been seeing Dr. Show who has been wonderful. She is very knowledgeable and thorough. She shares as much information as possible while allowing for questions, which has been valuable to us when going through difficult situations. She just helped us go through end of life treatment / decision making and we truly appreciated her openness to discuss the hard truths while also comforting us. We also appreciate the team reaching out with a thoughtful gesture after he passed. These little things make the difference. Thank you for taking care of our Millie and sweet Peanut Butter! 🦋💛
My dog and I have had great experiences with North Kenilworth! Dr Show and staff are very professional, knowledgeable and kind! Definitely recommend!

Went there, and they were awesome in so many ways, for my sweet little Abby who was 15 and she fell ill so  suddenly and people who worked there especially the vet was so nice and helped me to get thru the time having put my Abby to rainbow heaven and I would recommend this place to take good care of my in near future furball!!! Thank  you for your awesome support and service!
Thank you, Kelly, for your 5-star rating! We're thrilled to know you had a positive experience with us. We look forward to seeing you again soon in the near future!

My cat, Cheeto, goes in regularly for tech appts and to see the vets. Dr Show has researched food and gone above and beyond to ensure the prescription food Cheeto needs also supports my other cat since they are free fed. I appreciate their care!

I been with north k. For almost 15 years! I called for an emergency visit and was turned away! Really broke my heart since I brought ALL my dogs here, even on their last days! I really counted on North K,  but they finally let me down!

North Kenilworth takes such good care of our little zoo. The staff is very responsive and takes their time in appointments, explaining all care options thoroughly. The veterinarians also make sure to call to check up on our pets and explain test results clearly. We have loved every single vet that has supported our dogs and cat. We feel very lucky to have this sweet clinic in central Phoenix.
Vets who are scared of dogs

I recently moved downtown and visited North Kenilworth Veterinary Care with my Doberman, Phoenix. I had initially booked an appointment regarding a potential emergency issue (paraphimosis), but by the time of the appointment three days later, the issue had resolved. My primary goal for the visit then became obtaining necessary vaccinations and records for my new apartment.
I was disappointed by the clinic's rigid business model. I was informed that they would not provide vaccinations unless I first paid for the full 'emergency' checkup, claiming vaccinations are only 'add-ons.' It felt like the clinic was prioritizing a higher-priced ticket over the actual needs of the pet and the owner.
When I expressed that I would take my business elsewhere, there was no effort to accommodate the basic care my dog needed. It felt less like a medical practice and more like a high-pressure sales environment. If you are looking for a vet that is flexible to your pet's current status rather than stuck on a pre-booked 'emergency' price tag, I would suggest looking elsewhere.

Furthermore, I was out the $90-$100 deposit and wasted time  despite no medical service being performed

Amazing over the phone service. While I have not gone here, I had the pleasure of speaking over the phone with a lovely receptionist 2/20 9:50 am. I'm so sorry I forgot your name due to the nature of our call and how distraught I was because of my older dogs condition. I believe it started with a D, maybe diana or Denise. Either way, she was very compassionate and patient. She explained reasoning for x-rays and blood work better than the Dr at the other hospital I was taking him to. Thank you so much for the clarity and overall genuine concern for my situation ❤️.

I recommend that the rabies certificate be given to the dog owner the day of the shot.  I need to provide the certificate when licensing our dog.  I don't have it and I'm waiting for the veterinarian   to return from vacation to sign the form.  Hopefully I won't have to pay a late fee to Maricopa County.  Just my thought.

My cat was put down at Kenilworth after a long and happy life.  The staff at Kenilworth were always cheerful and friendly on every visit, and most importantly treated my cat with the utmost care.  I recommend them highly!
Jennifer, Thanks so much for taking the time to share your positive experience!  We look forward to keeping up the great work! See you soon!

North Kenilworth Veterinary Care is staffed by friendly, knowledgeable people who take care of our cats and dog in a professional manner. You can see that they are passionate about our babies,  and show empathy regarding the challenges we face as pet parents.
I love this place and the people here. They will take great care of your babies.
Friendly staff, great vet.
Hello Victoria. Thank you for giving us a Five-star rating! We're happy to know that you've had a great experience with us and look forward to your next visit.

I took a stray dog off the street. They had me wait few days before bringing in. I was 5 minutes late and was told my appointment was canceled and cannot make another one until I paid a deposit for a new appointment. These people are crazy, have no heart and from previous experience, not the best veterinarian either. I had been a long term client for years and this is how they treat people.

Update: we’ve been going here for almost 6 years and we still love it! Everyone is so kind and knowledgeable.

We’ve had the best experience with North Kenilworth. I was really nervous at first, as my pups first appointments were curbside, and I really didn’t want to leave her alone. But the staff were so kind and so informative, and Indy came back out tail wagging and happy. I felt really good knowing she was in good hands! Not to mention it has been incredibly easy to schedule appointments. So happy we found them!

We have two cats (17 & 19 year old immortalists), and two dogs (6 & 8 year old puppies). We have been taking our zoo to North Kenilworth since 2011. Since the amazing Dr. Holmes retired,  there has been a lot of turn over among his replacements - which I why write this review now, after all this time. Over the last two months, our dog Erwin has been seen by Dr. Alyssa Show several times in connection with an oral mass/tumor. While his formal diagnosis and treatment plan remains evolving, during such a difficult and uncertain time, we cannot express how grateful we are to have such an intelligent, detailed, and thoughtful team of staff and Dr. Show taking care of Erwin. Thank you all for everything.

Thankful is the word I would use for 'North Kenilworth Veterinary Care.'

I don't have any photos to post because I've technically never used their services before, but they helped my wife & I in a difficult situation.

A month & half ago, my wife was walking back from Chipotle when she noticed a deceased stray cat on the side of the road. She called me in tears & I immediately notified the city of the incident. The city mentioned it may take them a few days to retrieve the cat & I couldn't imagine others seeing this incident while traveling through the area. I called North Kenilworth & they said they'd take the stray in. I walked over with a towel, picked up the cat, & walked him into their clinic. They took him from me & completed the rest of the process.

I'm really grateful that they offered to do so. It's a tough image seeing a cat unfortunately lose their life, but North Kenilworth helped support without any charges. We ended up naming him Mickey in memory.

I plan to use them for my services in the future with my house cats because of their generosity.

Thank you North Kenilworth Veterinary Clinic for what you do!
Hi D. Thank you for your 5-Star review to us and happy to know that your experience with us was a great one and hope that your future visits are just the same.

We just adopted two kittens, Keo and Olive, and started taking them here for all their kitten checkups and vaccines. This vet office is amazing, staff are all super friendly and the two Veterinarians we saw were both amazing as well! So happy we found such a great place to make sure our pets are happy and healthy!
The staff is very friendly and knowledgeable, my dog Bella loves going there!
Dr Show is great in taking care of my 2 dogs. All the associates there are very gentle and kind. They also explain things so you can understand. They are the best for vet care, love them.

The employees that we have dealt with at Kenilworth are wonderful and the location is very convenient.  However, every time we have been there, we have seen a different veterinarian so there has been no opportunity to develop a relationship for ourselves and our dog. This is not ideal for us.
Really appreciate the staff and Dr.s!  They are always very welcoming and when it comes to diagnosing and treating an issue will give both short and long term recommendations.

The staff was very accommodating.  Im disabled and use a power chair.  They let me use the back entrance so it was no problem getting my girl in for her appointment.  She got all her shots, nails trimmed and check up fast and easily.  They were so good with Tilly, she's a shy chihuahua.  She loves people but gets a bit nervous.  They handled her so well! Definitely give them a chance to take care of all your furry babies.  Im glad I did.
I absolutely adore the staff at North Kenilworth. We are regulars and they always take such good care of my senior dog and treat us so well.
Judy, Thank you for your honest feedback. We would appreciate the opportunity to discuss this with you further so we can improve.

Every year veterinary has been changing, I guess it's sound....not good 🤷 even my dog's already used to it one person but every year check up it's different person,will not back anymore in this facility. …

They took care of my dogs so well. They are so gentle and understanding towards my dogs feelings. I took my big male German shepherd and even bigger Rottweiler  and they were wonderful. Thank you to the entire staff
Hello Larry. Thank you for giving us a five-star rating! We're happy to know that you've had a great experience with us and look forward to your next visit.

Our three dogs have been patients at North Kenilworth for years, and we're so grateful for the care they receive from the entire team.  From the time we walk in the door until we leave, all three are treated with love and kindness.  We've had two spayed/neutered, one gastropexy, allergic reaction visits, valley fever and dental visits (our dogs like to eat bees and other non-edible things) and each time we go in, it's like the dogs are personal pets of each staff member.

This place called me saying a person brought in a cat the found and scanned for a microchip. I verified it was indeed my cat and I would like to pick her up. They said the client didn't feel comfortable giving her information to me to set up a pick up... "but she would reach out to me" and then allowed this person to leave with my cat!!! I was on the phone asking for them to let me speak to the lady to find out a place do the exchange... they refused! Literally allowed this person tp leave with my cat!

Our beloved cat,age 17 received exceptional care by staff & excellent doctor,Alyssa Show.
She had cared for him when he was younger at another clinic. Although her new location is far
away from where we live,it was so important
that he again could be under her caring,watchful
attention.
Presently he is doing very well & despite his age
is alert, healthy & playful. May he continue to thrive with her guidance.
All staff were attentive & kept us well informed
most importantly they provided best attention
to our furry family member
Very grateful & appreciative for his wonderful
curative care.
Sincerely,Vannessa Sword
Thank you for giving us a 5-star rating! We're happy to know that you've had a great experience with us and will be passing it along to the team.
Thank you for giving us a 5-star rating! We're happy to know that you've had a great experience with us and it is always a pleasure to seeing you and your fur babies.
Excessive quote for dog teeth cleaning. Went to another very good vet and fee was about 40% less. Don’t recommend this corporate vet operation.
Hello Kathie, Thank you for giving us a Five-star rating! We're happy to know that you've had a great experience with us.

They did a wonderful job getting my cat back to health, but they never followed up after the treatment. Today, two months late, I get this survey in an email. If there would’ve been a follow up, I would’ve given them five stars.
My animals have been patients at North Kenilworth since 2019 and they’ve always received great care. From routine checkups to surgeries, the staff at NKV is always so caring and responsive.

North Kenilworth Vet provided me and my family exceptional care for my pup who became unexpectedly ill. They provided me with clear, concise options ranging from most aggressive options to conservative methods and allowed my dog, Callie, the best chance. Ultimately, they helped her pass with dignity prior to excessive suffering and helped us through the process by both explaining to us the process before and during while being incredibly sensitive. I would recommend to all to bring their loved ones here.
Love North Kenilworth! Been coming here for 5 years and I love the friendly and attentive staff!

My dog has horrible allergies and I was so in over my head. The vet spent so much time with me going over how to care for my dog’s needs and what I could do to help her. The staff were incredibly friendly and helpful. Making an appointment was a breeze, and so was rescheduling it. They even showed me more cost effective options for medication from another provider. You can tell this veterinarian actually cares about animals and owners.

Dr. Show and the team at North Kenilworth are the best! They always fit me in the schedule quickly and take the time to walk me through any questions I have about treatment for my cats. Everyone is friendly and helpful, I'm never waiting long, and pricing is affordable. I'm so grateful for all their work!
Hello Cameron, Thanks leaving such a great review! We're here for you anytime!
I drive here from Mesa to see Dr. Show, she's the best :)

They seem to truly care about animals.
I actually got better care for my cat here than Alta Vista.
Dear Madeline, Thanks for the great review! Hearing that your experience went well really makes our day.

I wish I never visited this vet care because the relief vet didn't believe me that my puppy, Honey does experience car sickness each time I take him in my car. I had never had a chance to meet Dr. Show because she was in surgery all day at my appointment on the 9th. I wasted a 90-dollar visit on her.

I asked the representative on the phone a few minutes ago if I could give him one full tablet of Cerenia instead of a half tablet of Cerenia because it would help him control his car sickness better today. She keeps telling me to give him a half tablet of Cerenia instead of a full tablet. I don't think she did ask Dr. Show.

Dr. Show demands me to have Honey make him take a Heartworm test before she can prescribe him heartworm prevention medications.

A puppy who is older than 8 weeks can get heartworm prevention medications without a blood test.

Dr. Show doesn't care about meeting the patients or saving patients money and time.

Dr Show wants more money from the patients instead of listening to the patient’s complaints regarding their pets’ problems.

I am not going to waste more of my money on Dr. Show.

I do not think I want to come back to this vet care and want to look for another high-quality vet care who listens and believes me.
Greetings Markeis, Thanks so much for taking the time to share your positive experience!
Very friendly explained everything
These technicians and Dr.s are always amazing. They really care about your fur babies and you. We now have 5 fur babies that go there.

They actually care about your pets here.
I have a cane corso with very bad anxiety but when I switched to North Kenilworth, his anxiety decreased dramatically. The staff are very good at handling agitated animals. I also got my little blue heeler spayed here and she recovered amazingly. The staff are kind and thorough when it comes to explaining procedures and reviewing pricing. Love this vet clinic.
A great, friendly practice in a charming historic building. Plenty of parking. Knowledgeable staff.

North Kenilworth used to be an amazing vet to bring all your pets too (I have 6 on record there that I used to bring regularly for the past 5-6 years). Once Dr. Holmes (and Dr. Kirk, she was the best!) left, I am not sure what happened behind the scenes but things have definitely gone downhill here. All the vets they had have left (coincidence? probably not.). The pushing of unnecessary tests and extreme costs of those tests have pushed me and my pets away from this vet (preying on people when they are vulnerable is not a good look and it is very obvious that it is being done). Want an appointment? Well, I hope it is not urgent because you will be waiting around 2 weeks to be seen. Once you do get an appointment on the books, have fun waiting in the lobby as they take your pet back and leave you sitting there (this happens more often than not, sometimes you might manage to get a room and be able to be there with your pet).

TLDR; save your money and time and go to one of the many other awesome vets in Central Phoenix that can accommodate the clients they have, this place cannot.

My concerns for my cats were growing and their previous vet did not give me satisfying answers to my questions. Diana and Dr Show were attentive, thorough and kind to my cats. I think these little guys will get the attention they need here.

I have been a customer since the end of last year, and this is the third time I get rude treatment from the technicians. I brought my dog Anya in today for her monthly injections and I was made to feel uncomfortable and like a liar for the clinic's own mistake of not keeping my dad's credit card information on file as he had requested on my previous visit last month when Anya had her physical exam.
I have many complaints, including from that specific exam day.

But I'll focus on today first: On my 9am appointment on August 1st I was asked to pay by the employee working the desk, I explained my dad had already provided his card information and it should be on file since last time I was there for her annual exam the technician even verified the last 4 digits with me given that when she tried to run the card it didn't work because they had entered some numbers wrong, so I called my dad and got the correct number for that tech.

This employee said: No the info is not here; so I tried detailing what happened last time, but she proceeded to cut me off while I was still speaking, I then continued to finish my thought and she kept talking over me!
I asked if they could check someplace else in their system and I was given a stern NO. This person stated that they could not ever save a card on file.

The technician that injected my dog was not helpful either, because I had to get to the point of asking if I needed to stay there until my dad returned my call to make the payment for her to propose to send my dad a text with a payment link, to which I replied that wasn't possible because he doesn't have a cell phone. This technician then said that if my dad called we could get the card saved on file, which is contrary to what the employee at the  computer told me in front of the technician.

To end the ordeal, I said, well hopefully this time the card is finally saved, and asked for the manager's name to settle this, this technician then answered Aja in an overall unpleasant and patronizing tone. I had manners and communicated in a respectful tone throughout the awkward treatment I got from these women. There were no empathic statements whatsoever.

The tech from today also said Anya had another medication on file to be injected each monthly visit and asked me to confirm if she does get this one, a medication that begins with the letter S. She said it always appears there, and I was just communicated this today? What if she had been administered this and it made her sick??

My other complaint is that the doctor that saw Anya last time for her annual exam didn't check her mobility by assessing her joints since she has arthritis. Also, when asked a clarifying question about how heartworm travels from one place to another she got very defensive because I didn't understand the way she explained something, and essentially got short with me and confrontational.

All in all, I've noticed there's a pattern of bad attitude from the employees as well as this one doctor. There's also frequent miscommunication and disorganization. But most importantly, they don't know how to act in a stable and customer-centric way. I am done being patient with their apparent discrimination as a woman that is an immigrant.

The team at North Kenilworth has been so kind and helpful for my 4 year old dog with severe anxiety. They’ve helped him find the right medications and supplements to help him feel at ease and able to enjoy life, and give him a safe calm environment to feel less afraid during vet visits.
Love this place.  The staff care about your pets and don’t try to oversell.
Excellent care, service and administration.

My dog had ear infection, vet wrote a script that was not available at any pharmacy due to the particular strength. The only place I was able to get it was at North Kenilworth, for 98.00. It was for Amoxicillin and vet would not change the …
